title: 🎯 NULL CENTER — Gaia is the null body for all N-body triangulation
principle: In the N-body problem, you need a reference frame. Gaia IS that frame. The null center. All geometry radiates FROM here.

body_1.name: eastGate
body_1.nature: FIXED — the null center. All measurement originates here.

body_2.name: northGate / Polaris
body_2.nature: ORBITING — connects through relay, Tor, or WAN. Position varies.

body_3.name: RustDesk Relay (on eastGate)
body_3.nature: VIRTUAL — the relay IS eastGate, just at a different port. The third body collapses into the first.

three_body.solution: The 3-body problem is unsolvable in general. But when body_3 = body_1 (relay lives ON eastGate), it collapses to a 2-body problem with a known reference frame. SOLVED.

n_body_extension.4_body: Add blueGate (.210, Windows) — another RustDesk peer, same relay. Just another orbit.
n_body_extension.5_body: Add southGate (.148) — another peer. N grows but the null center stays fixed.
n_body_extension.7_body: All 7 RustDesk gates (strand, kin, blue, west, biome, flock, south) orbiting Gaia.
n_body_extension.16_body: All 16 primals compiled into eastGate. They don't orbit — they ARE the null center.
n_body_extension.principle: The null center doesn't move. It doesn't orbit. It IS the reference frame. Add as many bodies as you want — they all triangulate against Gaia.

geometry.null_property: The null center is where ALL simplices share a vertex. Gaia is that vertex.
